description: This is a PHP source code file defining the PaymentMethod controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles checkout payment method selection, validation, saving, and related actions, including managing session data and generating JSON API responses.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: The PaymentMethod controller class manages the selection and validation of payment methods during checkout, including handling user sessions, loading language and model resources, and generating appropriate JSON responses for the client interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of available payment methods and current payment data, loading language strings, managing session variables, and rendering the payment method selection view.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns the available payment methods based on the current checkout address and cart status, validating cart contents, stock, and required addresses; outputs JSON with the payment options or errors.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected payment method and order comments to the session, validating cart contents, stock, addresses, and payment method options; outputs JSON indicating success or errors.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Retrieves or updates the order comment, linking it to the order and returning JSON status messages.

methods.name: agree
methods.description: Records the user's agreement to terms, storing it in session data, and responds with JSON confirmation.
